solution_text: By Ohm's law, I = V/R = 12/6 = 2 A.
tips: Use I = V/R when voltage and resistance are known.

solution_text: Using the lens relation 1/f = 1/v - 1/u with f = 20 cm and u = -40 cm gives 1/v = 1/20 - 1/40 = 1/40, so v = 40 cm.
tips: Use the Cartesian sign convention consistently in lens problems.

solution_text: Average speed equals total distance divided by total time. Therefore, average speed = 60/2 = 30 km/h.
tips: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.

solution_text: Kinetic energy is K = 1/2 mv^2. If speed changes from v to 2v, the kinetic energy changes by a factor of (2v)^2/v^2 = 4.
tips: Look for the power of the variable in proportionality questions.
